```{r}
    lapply(packages, FUN = function(x) {
        if (!require(x, character.only = TRUE)) {
            install.packages(x, dependencies = TRUE)
            library(x, character.only = TRUE)
        }
    })
}

fsave <- function(x, file = NULL, location = "./data/processed/") {
    ifelse(!dir.exists("data"), dir.create("data"), FALSE)
    ifelse(!dir.exists("data/processed"), dir.create("data/processed"), FALSE)
    if (is.null(file))
        file = deparse(substitute(x))
    datename <- substr(gsub("[:-]", "", Sys.time()), 1, 8)
    totalname <- paste(location, datename, file, ".rda", sep = "")
    save(x, file = totalname)  #need to fix if file is reloaded as input name, not as x. 
}
```

```{r}
#Jochem's formula for Moran's I

fMoran.I <- function(x, weight, scaled = FALSE, na.rm = FALSE, alternative = "two.sided", rowstandardize = TRUE) {
    if (rowstandardize) {
        if (dim(weight)[1] != dim(weight)[2])
            stop("'weight' must be a square matrix")
        n <- length(x)
        if (dim(weight)[1] != n)
            stop("'weight' must have as many rows as observations in 'x'")
        ei <- -1/(n - 1)
        nas <- is.na(x)
        if (any(nas)) {
            if (na.rm) {
                x <- x[!nas]
                n <- length(x)
                weight <- weight[!nas, !nas]
            } else {
                warning("'x' has missing values: maybe you wanted to set na.rm = TRUE?")
                return(list(observed = NA, expected = ei, sd = NA, p.value = NA))
            }
        }
        ROWSUM <- rowSums(weight)
        ROWSUM[ROWSUM == 0] <- 1
        weight <- weight/ROWSUM
        s <- sum(weight)
        m <- mean(x)
        y <- x - m
        cv <- sum(weight * y %o% y)
        v <- sum(y^2)
        obs <- (n/s) * (cv/v)
        if (scaled) {
            i.max <- (n/s) * (sd(rowSums(weight) * y)/sqrt(v/(n - 1)))
            obs <- obs/i.max
        }
        S1 <- 0.5 * sum((weight + t(weight))^2)
        S2 <- sum((apply(weight, 1, sum) + apply(weight, 2, sum))^2)
        s.sq <- s^2
        k <- (sum(y^4)/n)/(v/n)^2
        sdi <- sqrt((n * ((n^2 - 3 * n + 3) * S1 - n * S2 + 3 * s.sq) - k * (n * (n - 1) * S1 - 2 * n *
            S2 + 6 * s.sq))/((n - 1) * (n - 2) * (n - 3) * s.sq) - 1/((n - 1)^2))
        alternative <- match.arg(alternative, c("two.sided", "less", "greater"))
        pv <- pnorm(obs, mean = ei, sd = sdi)
        if (alternative == "two.sided")
            pv <- if (obs <= ei)
                2 * pv else 2 * (1 - pv)
        if (alternative == "greater")
            pv <- 1 - pv
        list(observed = obs, expected = ei, sd = sdi, p.value = pv)
    } else {
        if (dim(weight)[1] != dim(weight)[2])
            stop("'weight' must be a square matrix")
        n <- length(x)
        if (dim(weight)[1] != n)
            stop("'weight' must have as many rows as observations in 'x'")
        ei <- -1/(n - 1)
        nas <- is.na(x)
        if (any(nas)) {
            if (na.rm) {
                x <- x[!nas]
                n <- length(x)
                weight <- weight[!nas, !nas]
            } else {
                warning("'x' has missing values: maybe you wanted to set na.rm = TRUE?")
                return(list(observed = NA, expected = ei, sd = NA, p.value = NA))
            }
        }
        # ROWSUM <- rowSums(weight) ROWSUM[ROWSUM == 0] <- 1 weight <- weight/ROWSUM
        s <- sum(weight)
        m <- mean(x)
        y <- x - m
        cv <- sum(weight * y %o% y)
        v <- sum(y^2)
        obs <- (n/s) * (cv/v)
        if (scaled) {
            i.max <- (n/s) * (sd(rowSums(weight) * y)/sqrt(v/(n - 1)))
            obs <- obs/i.max
        }
        S1 <- 0.5 * sum((weight + t(weight))^2)
        S2 <- sum((apply(weight, 1, sum) + apply(weight, 2, sum))^2)
        s.sq <- s^2
        k <- (sum(y^4)/n)/(v/n)^2
        sdi <- sqrt((n * ((n^2 - 3 * n + 3) * S1 - n * S2 + 3 * s.sq) - k * (n * (n - 1) * S1 - 2 * n *
            S2 + 6 * s.sq))/((n - 1) * (n - 2) * (n - 3) * s.sq) - 1/((n - 1)^2))
        alternative <- match.arg(alternative, c("two.sided", "less", "greater"))
        pv <- pnorm(obs, mean = ei, sd = sdi)
        if (alternative == "two.sided")
            pv <- if (obs <= ei)
                2 * pv else 2 * (1 - pv)
        if (alternative == "greater")
            pv <- 1 - pv
        list(observed = obs, expected = ei, sd = sdi, p.value = pv)
    }


}
```

# RSiena

## Hanging Out Network

### Get Network, Separate waves

```{r}
#wave 1 = hangingt1, wave 2 = hangingt2
hangingt1m <- as.matrix(hanging_df_t1)
hangingt2m <- as.matrix(hanging_df_t2)
#diagonals to zero
diag(hangingt1m) <- 0
diag(hangingt2m) <- 0
#missings to NA
hangingt1mwna <- hangingt1m
hangingt1mwna[hangingt1mwna == 9] <- NA
hangingt2mwna <- hangingt2m
hangingt2mwna[hangingt2mwna == 9] <- NA
#missings to 0
hangingt1mnona <- hangingt1m
hangingt1mnona[hangingt1mnona == 9] <- 0
hangingt2mnona <- hangingt2m
hangingt2mnona[hangingt2mnona == 9] <- 0
#nets into array
hanging_array <- array(data = c(hangingt1mnona, hangingt2mnona), dim = c(dim(hangingt1mnona), 2))
hanging_arraynona <- array(data = c(hangingt1mnona, hangingt2mnona), dim = c(dim(hangingt1mnona), 2))
#dependent
net <- sienaDependent(hanging_array)
```

## Covariates: parenteduav, parentedudif, ethnew, gendernew

```{r}
gendercov <- coCovar(gendernew) #constant covariate
ethcov <- coCovar(ethnew)
parentedudifcov <- coCovar(parentedudif)
parenteduavcov <- coCovar(parenteduav)
mydata <- sienaDataCreate(net, gendercov, ethcov, parentedudifcov, parenteduavcov)
```

## Effects

```{r}
myeff0910 <- getEffects(mydata)
effectsDocumentation(myeff0910)
```
```{r}
ifelse(!dir.exists("results"), dir.create("results"), FALSE)
print01Report(mydata, modelname = "./results/edu_bridge")
```
First some basic effects that are not really of theoretical interest:
```{r}
myeff <- includeEffects(myeff0910, outAct, inPop, inAct, recip, GWESPFF)  
```
Now I'll introduce homophily:
```{r}
myeff <- includeEffects(myeff, simX, egoX, altX, interaction1 = "parenteduavcov")
myeff
```
```{r}
myAlgorithm <- sienaAlgorithmCreate(projname = "edu_bridge",
                                    MaxDegree = c(net = 10),
                                    seed = 30000)
mod1 <- siena07(myAlgorithm, data = mydata, effects = myeff) 
mod1
```
The overall convergence ratio is under .25, which is acceptable. Convergence of individual parameters is also sufficient. The rate parameter value is 7.34, indicating that each actor had, on average, 7.34 options for change within the simulation.
```{r}
test_parameter(mod1, tested=8) #Wald-type significance test
```
The estimate for homophily based on average parental educational attainment is positive, but relatively low and with a large standard error, indicating uncertainty. The Wald-type significance test indicates that the effect of similarity in average parental educational attainment is insignificant, p = .991. 
```{r}
myeff2 <- includeEffects(myeff, egoX, interaction1 = "parentedudifcov")
myeff2
```
```{r}
myeff2 <-  set_interaction(myeff2, list(simX, egoX), covar1=c("parenteduavcov", "parentedudifcov"))
myeff2
```
```{r}
mod2 <- siena07(myAlgorithm, data = mydata, effects = myeff2) 
mod2
```
